do_more: Start with a vivid, relatable scenario in the first 2‑3 seconds
Focus each short on ONE clear psychology concept and name it in the title
Use the “The X …” title pattern with a curiosity‑driving twist
Keep the runtime around the standard ~42 seconds, but pack the hook early
Add a visual gag or exaggeration that reinforces the concept
avoid: Generic or vague titles without a specific concept
Introducing multiple ideas or a long setup before the hook
Overly abstract language that drops viewer interest
Running the video much longer than 45 seconds
short.title_style: Use a concise “The [Concept] [Surprising Hook]” format that promises a quick, unexpected insight
next_tests: A/B test 30‑second tight versions vs 42‑second standard to see retention impact
Experiment with opening questions vs bold statements as the first hook
Try titles that include a numeric hook (e.g., “3 Ways…”) versus the simple “The X” format
